Notion Part 3: Using Notion AI for Instant Answers

This article is part 3 of my mini-series about Notion! Here’s the list of articles:

  1. For total beginners: Why I’m obsessed with it, and how to get started with Notion at your company.

  2. For those with Notion experience: The #1 most important Notion page that you must have.

  3. (this article) For those who already have a robust Notion buildout: How you can use Notion’s AI feature to drastically reduce repeat questions, save labor costs, and reduce mistakes.

Because my property management business is fully documented, I’m able to take time off without stressing about the company, or even checking in at all. In fact I’m taking the month of June off again this year, just as I have for the past two years. Does that grab your attention?

The tool we use to do this is called Notion [here’s a video walkthrough of our company Notion buildout]. In parts 1 and 2 linked above, I shared details of exactly how we use it. In this article, I want to show you a new feature called Notion AI.

Notion AI is a natural-language chat featured built right into Notion. I recently recorded a video for my team showing them how it works… take a look at this:

Amazing Notion Update - Watch Video

I don’t know about you, but I’m blown away by this.

In looking at the data that Notion provides on usage, I’m able to see that my team is indeed taking advantage of this feature, thus saving myself and other managers potentially hours per week by heading off basic questions and letting team members answer their own questions.

If you’ve started building out your own company Notion, try out Notion AI by getting on the waitlist as soon as you can.

That wraps up my 3-part series on Notion… now get building!
